newsitem.title: USA: Orange County, N.C., eyes $40 mln bond referendum.
newsitem.headline: Orange County, N.C., eyes $40 mln bond referendum.

text.p: Commissioners in Orange County, N.C., have asked a school task force to recommend by April 1 how big of a bond referendum should go before voters in November.
The deadline was set at a meeting commission meeting Tuesday.
The chairman of the task force, Rev. Robert Seymour, said it was unlikely the panel's recommendation would exceed $40 million. School officials have identified $50 million of capital needs.

But a preliminary plan approved by the county commissoners in October said a bond issue larger than $40 million would require a property tax increase, something several commissioners ahve said the would not support.
